TABLE.NAME: report_transcript_issue
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per issued transcript: the verification code and a snapshot of the rows exactly as they were issued.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The learner the transcript is about.

FIELD.NAME: issuerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who triggered the issue. Equals userid for a self-download; 0 once that user has been deleted.

FIELD.NAME: code
FIELD.COMMENT: Verification code, unique, from an unambiguous upper-case alphabet.

FIELD.NAME: documenttitle
FIELD.COMMENT: The document title setting at issue time.

FIELD.NAME: snapshot
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: the rows as rendered plus the settings that shaped them.
